messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency breach for customer=whirlpool (service=streaming-gateway). Severity: P2. Paging on-call. 

eric-oncall: on it. seeing alert — p95 is up ~900ms, p99 spiking to ~3.2s. streaming stalls reported from customer console. taking ownership.

maria-sre: FYI, metrics show a sudden fanout of concurrent streaming sessions from a single tenant starting 2024-11-05T14:12Z. concurrency jumped from 120 -> 950 over 3m.

julia-eng: any recent deploys to serving runtime? I see a tiny rollout earlier but not obvious correlation. pinning rollout id: r-20241105-09 if needed.

devon-support: customer (Whirlpool) says their app triggered a bulk batch of prompt expansions. Quote: "we started a background scrape that opened 800 streams concurrently". They say they can throttle on their side but need a mitigation now.

eric-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) enable customer-level concurrency cap at 200 2) enable prefix KV-caching for this tenant 3) increase dedicated pool from 4->6 GPUs for the next 15m 4) enable streaming chunk-size=256 to reduce stall risk. Doing 1 and 2 now.

julia-eng: i'm deploying the concurrency cap via routing policy. command: 
```
redwoodctl routes update --tenant whirlpool --concurrency-limit 200
```

julia-eng: applied. verify in router: `curl -s http://router-admin/tenants/whirlpool | jq .concurrency_limit` shows 200.

eric-oncall: enabling prefix caching for tenant in cache service. patching config: 
```
cachectl set tenant:whirlpool prefix_kv_cache=true ttl=600
```

eric-oncall: cache enabled. watching p99.

incident-bot: NOTE: auto-scaling event: dedicated-pool-whirlpool scaled from 4 -> 6 GPUs at 14:18Z (reason: manual-scale).

maria-sre: dashboard: p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 820ms after cap + cache + scale. p95 at ~420ms. still above SLO for p95 target=200ms. streaming stalls reduced but not eliminated.

devon-support: customer confirms reduced error rate, but they report short stalls at session init (first bytes).

eric-oncall: digging into tail traces. query: `logs query --service=streaming-gateway --filter "tenant=whirlpool AND tag=stall" --since 1h`

eric-oncall: found repeated stalls tied to long prefix loads: many requests with 32k token context leading to KVCACHE misses and large memcopy on host->gpu. sample trace id: trace-7a2b.

julia-eng: that makes sense. large prompt + high concurrency = KV cache thrash and prefetch pressure. two immediate options: 1) reject requests with context > 16k for this tenant 2) enable incremental KV prefetch (experimental) to avoid big copy spikes.

eric-oncall: let's set a soft reject for contexts > 16k for 30m and auto-upgrade later if needed. applying policy now.

julia-eng: policy applied via policy engine: `policyctl add --tenant whirlpool --rule "max_context_tokens: 16000, mode: soft_reject" --ttl 1800`

maria-sre: after context cap, p99 down to ~450ms, p95 ~210ms. close to SLO but still slightly high for some sessions. latency distribution shows tail concentrated on first-chunk generation.

devon-support: Whirlpool reports they patched their background task to backoff. They want to resume full load later; recommend a gradual ramp.

eric-oncall: agree. action items: 1) keep concurrency cap 200 for 1h, then ramp to 400 over 15m if metrics stable 2) keep context cap 16k for 1h 3) monitor p95/p99 and streaming error rate 4) follow up with infra to bake incremental prefetch as a mitigation.

julia-eng: raising a follow-up task: RDW-3567 "incremental KVCACHE prefetch to mitigate large-context thrash". assign to eng-runtime.

maria-sre: creating post-incident note for timeline. severity P2, customer impact: increased tail latency and short stalls for ~35m, mitigations applied: tenant concurrency cap, context cap, dedicated pool scale, prefix KV cache.

devon-support: flagged for Customer Success: let Whirlpool know we did soft throttle & context cap and will coordinate ramp.

whirlpool-support: thanks all. we've resumed normal ops with our adjusted backoff. appreciate the quick mitigation.

eric-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. keep monitoring for 30m before resolve. I'll hand over to maria for RCA and follow-up.

maria-sre: taking handoff. writing RCA draft and impact calc: estimated 12k requests affected, approx 0.8% increased error rate for the window. will link doc here when done.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, pages silence scheduled in 30m.

eric-oncall: thanks team. closing my on-call loop. if anything regresses ping `#incidents` and i'll jump back in. :white_check_mark:
